title: The Fox and the Bug
source: Adapted from Aesop's Fables (public domain); vocabulary simplified to short-vowel decodable words for grade-1 oral reading (2026-09 content fix).
text: A fox and a bug had a run. "I will win," said the fox. The bug just went on and on. The fox ran fast and got up the hill. Then the fox sat for a nap in the sun. The bug did not rest. The bug got to the end. Then the fox got up and ran fast. But the bug was at the end. The bug won the run.
comprehension_hint_topics: what the fox did on the hill
